-36.01674,146.61881: Major Mitchell. Explorer. Passed here 17th Oct 1836.
-36.44676,146.69221: Murmungee Hall. Built in 1869. By local residents for use as school hall and church. School fees - one shilling per week for first two children of a family and sixpence for any more of same family. Classified 'B' Highly Significant to be Preserved,
